about: The module's windows as the harness drew them (probe 08, audit/harness/probes/08-capture-windows.mjs): one file a window, its element's HTML; each row its opener, its title, classes and buttons, or why it was not captured. Written by the probe from a run, never by hand.

windows.opener: trial-floor-ui.mjs m.confirmReveal({ id: "probe08", name: "The torn ticket", text: "" }, { left: 0 })
windows.title: Monokuma's Reveal

windows.opener: vote.mjs onBallotOpened (the GM's vote.open to p1)
windows.title: Who did it?

windows.opener: use-items.mjs (a => m.useItem(a, a.items.find(i => i.name === "Probe odd vial")))(game.actors.find(a => a.type === "character" && a.isOwner))
windows.title: Use Probe odd vial

windows.opener: level-up.mjs m.runAdvancementBatch(game.actors.filter(a => a.type === "character" && !a.getFlag("danganronpa-rpg", "monokuma")).slice(0, 3), "standard", { onGiving: () => { throw new Error("probe 08: the window is captured, nothing is given"); } })
windows.title: The class's Level Ups

windows.opener: rest.mjs m.takeRest(game.actors.find(a => a.type === "character" && a.isOwner), "short", { free: true, ignoreRoom: true, ignoreLimit: true, quiet: true })
windows.title: Short Rest
